question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.

Can I please __request __you all to stand up?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"request"** means to ask for something politely or formally. (अनुरोध करना)

 
 
• **Example: **I would like to **request** a day off next week.
 
 
 
• **"Plead"** refers to making an emotional or earnest appeal or request. (विनती करना)
 
 
• **Example: **She** pleaded **with her parents to let her go to the concert.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **plead.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Claim **(दावा करना): To assert that something is the case.

 
 
• **Example:** He claimed that he had seen a UFO.
 
 
 
• **Petition **(याचिका): A formal written request, typically one signed by many people, appealing to authority concerning a particular cause.
 
 
• **Example: **The citizens filed a petition to stop the construction of the factory.
 
 
 
• **Require** (आवश्यकता होना): To need something or make something necessary.
 
 
• **Example:** The project requires careful planning and execution.
